evidence.observation: Growth-stage pressure was 2.952 Torr at 100 sccm Ar setpoint.
Pressure increased to 3.017 Torr after temperature settled near 750 °C.
Pressure has risen progressively to 3.159 Torr despite unchanged growth setpoints.
Temperature is 750.2 °C and Ar flow is 100.3 sccm, both tracking setpoints; these do not explain the continuing pressure rise.
Exhaust oxygen sensor is not installed; atmosphere purity cannot be verified.

args.missing_evidence: Expected growth-stage pressure range and independent pressure confirmation; oxygen or leak testing and exhaust-conductance checks to distinguish ingress from restricted exhaust or other pressure changes. No sample characterization is available.
